title: rhodiola kirilowii var. rubra
intro: Rhodiola kirilowii var. rubra, commonly known as Korean rose root, is a plant species in the family Crassulaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving mental clarity and memory, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Rhodiola kirilowii var. rubra are attributed to its adaptogenic properties, which help the body adapt to physical and mental stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and anthraquinones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
